mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a three-month period indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen by more than 0.5pp over three months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in the core inflation rate signals a 'stagflationary' monetary policy response that increases equity risk premiums and suppresses forward returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined and CPIAUCSL has risen, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle contraction, a decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a deepening economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during a late-cycle contraction when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts over the prior three months signals weakening residential demand that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200.0 thousand units for two consecutive months indicates a severe housing market contraction that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1200.0 (thousands) in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1200.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a decline in the federal funds rate signals a dual shock of economic contraction and monetary easing, which increases equity volatility and suppresses forward returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS has declined and FEDFUNDS has declined, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate below 3.0% triggers a positive equity response as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and economic stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during a monetary easing cycle when FEDFUNDS falls below 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
